run_routed_experts_inference: run offline inference on a MoE model to capture routed experts data for each generated token
test_routed_expert_ids: test that all expert IDs in routed experts are within valid range [0, num_experts)
test_routed_experts_determinism: test routed experts determinism by running inference twice and comparing results with a mismatch threshold
validate_routed_experts_shapes: validate that routed experts arrays have at least 2 dimensions and log their shapes
compare_routed_experts_runs: compare routed experts from two inference runs and return the mismatch ratio
